# Draft submission to sindresorhus/awesome (NOT SUBMITTED)

Do not open this until the list has traction: the awesome index requires a
list that is well established, has a few weeks of history since creation, and
passes `awesome-lint` cleanly.

## Pre-submission checklist

- [ ] `npx awesome-lint` passes with no errors
- [ ] Repo has a description, topics, and the `awesome-list` topic
- [ ] License present (CC0-1.0)
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md present
- [ ] Table of contents matches headings
- [ ] Awesome badge in the heading
- [ ] List has been public and maintained for at least a few weeks with real
      commit history
- [ ] Entries re-verified for staleness on the day of submission

## Draft pull request text

Title:

    Add Awesome Agent Observability

Body:

    ## https://github.com/anhermon/awesome-agent-observability

    A curated list of tools, standards, and platforms for tracing,
    evaluating, and governing LLM and AI-agent applications: the
    OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions and SIG, OTel-based
    instrumentation, tracing and eval platforms, guardrails, LLM gateways,
    and Model Context Protocol tooling.

    Existing awesome lists cover LLM applications and MLOps broadly, but
    none focus on the observability and evaluation layer for agents, which
    now has its own standards track inside OpenTelemetry.

    Every entry was verified to resolve and to have been updated within the
    last 12 months; archived and abandoned projects are removed on each
    audit. Descriptions state what a project does rather than repeating its
    marketing copy.

    - [x] I have read and followed the instructions in the contributing
          guidelines
    - [x] The list is not a duplicate
    - [x] `awesome-lint` passes
